title: Raise renewal nudge send window to 21:00
summary: Open rate for the renewal reminder peaks at 19:00–21:00. Proposing the sending window be extended by two hours for jrn_renewal_nudge only.

title: Paused Win-back WhatsApp campaign
summary: Unsubscribe rate crossed 2.7% over three sends. Campaign paused pending copy review.

title: Swapped welcome hero image
summary: Replaced welcome-hero.png with the 26/27 kit variant across the welcome series.

title: Add SMS fallback to the welcome series
summary: Proposed an SMS step for opt-ins with no email engagement after 7 days. Rejected: no SMS transport is configured.
rejectionReason: No SMS transport configured; revisit after Q4 procurement.

title: Tightened High-value fans threshold
summary: Raised the lifetime spend floor from SAR 750 to SAR 1,000. Audience shrank from 11,204 to 8,412 profiles.

title: Launched Season-ticket renewal nudge
summary: Journey moved from draft to live with 412 profiles enrolled on entry.
